title: CivicTheme colour recipe
description: The durable artefact of a sub-theme's colour intent (uplift plan §4.4 + the additions key): brand inputs plus the override and addition sets. Everything else — resolved DTCG JSON, CSS custom properties, Figma mode files — is a build output of this file.

brands.description: Brand colour inputs per mode. At P1–P4 these flow into the color.brand tokens (emitted to Figma, never to CSS); from P5 they also drive palette generation.

overrides.description: Per-token overrides of existing CivicTheme tokens, keyed by token path (e.g. color.palette.highlight). Never touches shipped defaults — resolution is override ?? current-default ?? alias.

additions.description: New tokens the recipe adds (session-11 decision): custom palette slots (which may carry a contrast target and join Contrast QA) and component tokens, including new component groups. Addition paths must not collide with existing tokens.

valueSpec.description: A value override: per-mode literals and/or an alias re-point. A mode literal wins over $value; a mode with neither keeps the token's current default.

additionSpec.description: An added token: the same value shape as an override (a light value — literal or $value alias — is required), plus an optional contrast target for Contrast QA (`against` defaults to color.palette.background-light).
